notes: New to Crisp? The first time it opens, it restores a built-in sample on its own, then offers one button, "Make it look amazing", on your first clip, and opens the result on a before-and-after slider. When a free export stops at 15 seconds, Crisp now asks one clear question about your video: a large before-and-after from the part you have not got yet, the price, and a plain "Not now". After you enter your key, one click exports the whole video. Crisp also sends two more anonymous counts, once each: the first time it opens, and the first time a free export reaches the free limit. No name, file or identifier is sent; the privacy page lists exactly what is.
